story_structure.value: And–But–Therefore (clarity — the series spine). AND: a story copies itself into every memory that hears it (L4–L7). BUT: told once and never repeated, it fades in every head at once (L8–L9). THEREFORE: the story was the first backup (L10–L11). L12 is a marked bridge after the close.
